avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction decreases megestrol acetate plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue St. John's Wort prior to megestrol initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases megestrol exposure and risk of adverse effects
avoid_supplements.action: Advise patient to avoid grapefruit products; consider alternative supplement if needed

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Megestrol may increase bone loss risk; adequate calcium/vitamin D intake may mitigate osteoporosis development
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bone health; ensure adequate supplementation; recommend DEXA screening with prolonged use

caution_supplements.name: Herbal CYP3A4 inducers (Echinacea, Rifampin-containing products)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may reduce megestrol efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor therapeutic response; dosage adjustment may be necessary with concurrent use

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases megestrol plasma concentrations; risk of dose-dependent adverse effects
caution_foods.action: Advise patient to eliminate grapefruit from diet during megestrol therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase megestrol absorption; variable effect on bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern for stable drug levels

monitoring_notes: Monitor for thromboembolic events, fluid retention, and hyperglycemia. Assess bone density and lipid panels periodically, especially with prolonged megestrol use for appetite stimulation or cancer therapy.
